Case File #1: ₹4 lakh vanished from a factory. Can you guess where?

This is an illustrative example of a story many manufacturers know. The supplier was short by just 20 kg. The machines lost their usual 1.5%. The store room matched the register. The real leak was the night shift, losing 7.5% while the day and evening shifts lost about 1.5%.

Nobody saw it because yield was checked once a year. A daily yield report for each shift would have shown it in the first week.
